decisions.reason: The modular plant concept fits the firm's core systems business and has already shown a strong quantified customer saving, so management would very likely continue it.
As a flagship multi-model line closely tied to the firm's strategic direction in modular environmental technology, it is highly unlikely to be withdrawn in the next year.

The mobile trommel screen sensibly complements the firm's recycling portfolio, but with less visible proof of market traction than the flagship modular lines it carries a somewhat higher withdrawal risk.

The new slow-speed shredder line appears to be a more committed refreshed offering after the earlier product withdrawal, so a growing machinery firm would likely keep developing it rather than exit the segment again immediately.

The mobile spiral shaft screens extend the firm's application-specific processing range and support its modular systems strategy, making near-term withdrawal relatively unlikely despite their recent launch.
